pkgmetadata.longdescription: Powerlevel10k is a Zsh theme that emphasizes speed, flexibility, and out-of-the-box experience. This package builds the exact gitstatus commit this powerlevel10k release bundles (not any of gitstatus's own tagged releases, which do not match it -- see the ebuild for the diff that proved this) and installs it alongside the theme files at the location powerlevel10k looks for by default, so no extra shell configuration is needed beyond sourcing the theme itself. It does not depend on app-shells/gitstatus, which tracks gitstatus's real releases independently and is not guaranteed to match what any given powerlevel10k release bundles.
